{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check the revenue column for thousands separators
print("First 5 values of revenue:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Display the shape and basic info
print("Shape of the dataframe:", df.shape)
print("Unique values in channel:", df['channel'].unique())
print("Unique values in customer_segment:", df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Unique values in status:", df['status'].unique())

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))

# Show the first few rows
print("First 5 rows:")
print(df.head())"}
